body:
User asked (verbatim):
  when i open tab it is not creata a group befeor it sused ot greate a chroem tab group for easy navigaito

Context:
  URL/page: Tabsona popup (0.3.0 build loaded unpacked; 0.3.0 also in Store review)
  Files: apps/extension/src/engine/tabgroups.ts, engine/service.ts (openPersona, openSession, addSite), core/settings.ts (useTabGroups default true)
  Conversation thread: after the 0.3.0 work (settings tab, badge settings, persona colours with restyleGroupsForPersona) the user reports tabs are no longer grouped.

Acceptance:
  Opening a persona (and opening a site/session of a persona) puts its tabs in a Chrome tab group named and coloured after the persona again, with Settings > Tabs > group switched on; covered by an end-to-end check that fails without the fix.
title: Opening a persona/session no longer creates a Chrome tab group
